name: Assistant · Email in
description: Polls the agency inbox and hands each new email to Ingest message.

parameters.content:
## Email
Checks the agency inbox every minute (Gmail, not mail sent from it). Each new email is turned into the common format (new text only, without the quoted history) and stored by **Ingest message**; the same email is never stored twice. The reply is saved as a Gmail **draft** in the same thread for a person to review and send (see Send message).
